nodes.name: Keys are for apps, not agents.
nodes.text: ## Keys are for apps, not agents.

nodes.name: Workspace API keys let your sites, apps and services read…
nodes.text: Workspace API keys let your sites, apps and services read NullDull products. They are separate from agent connections: the CLI and MCP never accept a key in place of a login, and keys can’t write, read Secrets, reach private Grid drafts or administer anything.

nodes.name: Workspace owners and admins manage keys in the browser…
nodes.text: Workspace owners and admins manage keys in the browser under **Workspace settings → API keys**. Agents can’t create or manage keys.

nodes.name: Choose **Create API key**, give it a name and choose its…
nodes.text: Choose **Create API key**, give it a name and choose its type and access.

nodes.name: - A **Public** key (`nd_pub_…`) can only read **Published…
nodes.text:
- A **Public** key (`nd_pub_…`) can only read **Published Grid content**. It’s safe to include in browser and mobile apps and can be viewed again later.
- A **Private** key (`nd_sec_…`) belongs on your server. It is shown only once—copy it and choose **I’ve stored it**. NullDull keeps only a hash. A private key can also have **Memory (read-only)** or **Locale export (read-only)** access, acting as the member who created it within that member’s current access.

nodes.name: **Rotate** replaces a key; the old value stops working…
nodes.text: **Rotate** replaces a key; the old value stops working immediately. Removing the member who created a private key revokes its Memory access.

nodes.name: The client SDKs are open source at…
nodes.text: The client SDKs are open source at [github.com/doubco/nulldull-sdks](https://github.com/doubco/nulldull-sdks) and published at 0.1.0 as early access releases. They only read.

nodes.name: To render Grid pages in React, use `@nulldull/grid-react`…
nodes.text: To render Grid pages in React, use `@nulldull/grid-react` with `@nulldull/grid-core`, both on npm at 0.1.0.

nodes.name: - Memory and Locale calls need the workspace ID: a key…
nodes.text:
- Memory and Locale calls need the workspace ID: a key cannot look up its own workspace. The workspace root has the same ID as the workspace.
- Only public keys belong in browser and mobile apps. `@nulldull/react` refuses a private key in a browser.
- Published Grid reads need a key with the Published Grid content scope. A key from another workspace sees the pool as missing.
- An invalid, revoked or rotated key returns `401` with `INVALID_KEY`; it is never treated as an anonymous reader.
- The SDKs retry reads at most twice, after `429` or a temporary server error. Errors include the API’s code and request ID—include the request ID if you contact us.
